fields.summary: Autonomous plan run for the bug where runs started builder and verifier sessions with /rhiza-builder and /rhiza-verifier after the daemon auto-updated, while the installed guide was the older one: 16 sessions opened with 'Unknown command', each cost an attempt, and four sat idle. The planner read the daemon re-exec (internal/daemon/reexec.go, daemonLoop and daemonStartState in internal/api/daemon.go), the guide-currency test in status (installedVersion, pluginCurrent in internal/api/status.go), guide.install, the health parts, the session launch and the usage-limit transcript watch (internal/api/session_run.go). One transcript showed the agent writing a system message 'Unknown command: /rhiza-builder. Did you mean /rhiza-build?' and no prompt submitted. There was no owner. The planner raised three choices (when the daemon refreshes guides, what happens to a run whose start command is unknown, and how health reports a stale guide), and the arbiter answered with Decision decision-guide-refresh-start-fail-health: refresh installed guides at every daemon start, before any agent step; if a refresh fails, hold the agent steps whose start skill is missing, with one inbox item, until the guide is current; check before launch that the start command's skill is installed, and fail at once with an environment failure that uses no role attempt and holds the run in the inbox; as a backstop, fail a session that goes idle after SessionStart without UserPromptSubmit within a short grace; add a machine-level health part, guide, after usage, that is warn while a guide is stale or missing a skill a workflow starts, and never bad. Leaves were written from that Decision under the daemon, rex-sessions and health-command capabilities.
fields.title: Fix Runs started agent: autonomous plan interview
